model_inputs.structure_note: Driver-led telecom build (no DCF; policy). Five segments: AC Wireless and Home (driven: postpaid phone subs x wireless service revenue per sub + subs x FY2025 equipment revenue per sub $310.6/yr + consumer fiber/AIA connections x ARPU), AC Business Wireline (business fiber, transitional, other; plain), Legacy (driven: retained share of 2025 copper revenue), Latin America (Mexico, held for sale from 3Q26 so no depreciation after Q3, ~1 quarter in 2027, nil in 2028; plain), Corporate (unallocated cost in corporate_ebit). Driven share of base revenue 86.2%, base residual 0.0%. Capex = cap_inv / revenue. Round 2: segment margins are set from an Advanced Connectivity EBITDA path (FY2025 44,547; 2026 47,320 = 9M 35,920 + Q4 11,400; +6.0% 2027, +5.5% 2028) less AC D&A, so total adj. EBITDA is 48.1B / 49.0B / 50.7B. The stated P/E EPS, the stated FCF-yield FCF/share and net debt at the horizon are now driver-linked through driver_build.set (linear in the driver ids: EBIT = AC W&H margin x driven revenue + Legacy margin x 8,472 x legacy_ret + fixed segment/corporate EBIT; FCF = EBITDA - cap_inv - interest - cash taxes + other CFO items), so ARPU, subscriber and capex moves re-value all three legs. Value sits in three horizon multiples on NTM (Oct-2027 to Oct-2028) figures: EV/adj. EBITDA 6.2x (0.45), P/E 8.0x (0.40), FCF yield 12.4% (0.15). Minorities 17,985 and parent preferred 2,950 are debt-like; Forged Fiber stake +4,058 x 0.9 and an expected upper C-band payment -6,000 x 0.35 are adjustments.
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) EBITDA 2028 +3.5% (ex-Mexico +3.9%) is below the company's '5% or better in 2028' and MarketScreener consensus 51,989 (mine 50,674), because AC EBITDA sits in the low half of the mid-to-high-single-digit guide under SpaceX-led promotional risk while Legacy EBITDA falls ~1B a year; this is the main variant (+$1.3B 2028 EBITDA = ~+$1.0/share). (2) FCF rebuilt from the cash-flow bridge (supervisor finding): 2026 calibrates to ~$18.1B (9M 12,129 + Q4 ~6B) with +1.7B of non-EBITDA CFO items; 2027 $18.6B (2% under the $19B+ floor) and 2028 $19.9B (5% under $21B+), with cash taxes 1.0B/1.6B as the OBBBA benefit fades. (3) Equipment revenue is tied to subs at the FY2025 $310.6/sub, which understates 2026 equipment by ~$1.1B (near-zero margin, EBIT unaffected). (4) The pension/OPEB credit sits in other income (2.0B/1.8B in 2027/28): it is in EPS (P/E leg) but not EBITDA; the $8.1B postemployment obligation is not deducted. (5) Net debt at the horizon is driver-linked: 149,819 - Q4'26 FCF 6.0B - 0.75 x 2027 FCF (gate fix of 0.72) + dividends 7.30B + preferred 0.15B + buybacks 8.1B (2.5B Q4'26 + 5.6B Jan-Oct 2027) + NCI distributions 1.6B - Mexico (2.0B cash + 1.209B HFS leases) x 0.9 = 144.1B. (6) The SpaceX threat is carried only in the 6.2x multiple (no separate deduction). fair_value.value equals the engine's base horizon value.
